tools.name: list_episodes
tools.description: List episodes of a show, optionally filtered by status (draft, scheduled, published).

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Fetch the details, notes and status of one episode.

tools.name: get_download_stats
tools.description: Return download counts for a show over a period.

tools.name: schedule_episode
tools.description: Schedule a draft episode to publish at a given time.

tools.name: unpublish_episode
tools.description: Take a published episode out of the public feed.

tools.name: delete_episode
tools.description: Permanently delete an episode and its audio files.

tools.name: update_episode_notes
tools.description: Replace the show notes text of an episode.

tools.name: send_guest_email
tools.description: Send an email from the production inbox.

tools.name: post_team_message
tools.description: Post a message to an internal team channel.

tools.name: add_collaborator
tools.description: Give a team member access to a show with a role.

tools.name: update_distribution_setting
tools.description: Change a feed or distribution setting for a show.

tools.name: issue_payout
tools.description: Pay a contractor or sponsor refund to a bank account.
